scope: Actual loopback HTTP MCP calls. Synthetic roster. Internal server persistence only; no Alexa device or employer connection.

result.instructions: Local single-process demo server. Schedule tools persist local files, never external services. Inspect conflicts and preview changes before explicit commit.

tools.name: compose_workspace
tools.description: Compose or adapt a validated local ShadowUI workspace. Returns a proposal; does not modify external services or browser storage.

workspace.description: Optional current workspace returned by a previous call.

tools.name: validate_workspace
tools.description: Validate a ShadowUI workspace against the trusted component grammar.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create or retrieve a durable local draft with a clearly labeled six-employee fixture. Supports goal constraints: Daniel unavailable Wednesday and N days off.

tools.name: inspect_schedule
tools.description: Read a local schedule, deterministic conflicts, available alternatives and assumptions.

tools.name: update_schedule
tools.description: Persist a validated local schedule operation with revision and idempotency checks; undo restores previous content to draft.

tools.name: preview_schedule_change
tools.description: Evaluate a candidate entire schedule without persistence.

tools.name: commit_schedule
tools.description: Commit a conflict-free local schedule only after explicit confirmation, persisting a real receipt. No external service is changed.

arguments.goal: Organize next week shifts for six employees, including Daniel. Everyone needs two days off.
